public_claim: phi_engine.pipeline.profile deterministically profiles column VALUES locally (never leaves the process, never sent to an LLM) and drives two rules in run_pipeline: ESCALATION force-drops a keep-classified header whose values are majority PHI-shaped (catches PHI planted in an unexpectedly-named column); AUTO-CLEAR un-holds a force-dropped header whose value shape structurally proves it cannot be an identifier/date series (closed categorical set, zero blocking/warn/date signal) -- never overrides an explicit human drop decision
